archived.description: Whether or not the Attribute has been archived

condition_type.description: Whether this Attribute is a custom dimension or custom attribute. If this is a custom dimension, it belongs to an Optimizely Classic experiment and is read-only.

description.description: A short description of the Attribute

id.description: The unique identifier for the Attribute

key.description: Unique string identifier for this Attribute within the project

last_modified.description: The last time the Attribute was modified

name.description: The name of the Attribute. For Full Stack projects, the name will be set to the value of the key.

project_id.description: The ID of the project the Attribute belongs to
